g.text: From clean demonstrations to randomized scenes
Same frozen policy · task context built from clean demonstrations only
Frames progress left to right within each rollout. Each rollout is the first success of its condition.
Original manuscript examples · 4 tasks · selected successful episodes, not aggregate performance
